spec.scene: A patch of gray office carpet sits bathed in warm amber and violet sunset light streaming through a tall window frame at the back edge. In the center, a long wooden desk is crowded with tangled cables and slim silver energy-drink cans. At the center of the desk, an open laptop glows with a miniature colorful landscape on its screen. Three small figures in dark hoodies celebrate around the desk with raised arms. On the floor in front, an open cardboard box holds cold pizza slices.
spec.title: First Render at Sunset
spec.caption: The first world finally rendered at sunset and we all screamed.
